foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 对上市公司无笼统的外资持股比例上限；《外汇及外国贸易法》（FEFTA）要求外国投资者在「核心业务领域」（含半导体、国防装备、网络安全等指定行业）持有上市公司股份达1%以上时须事前申报并接受国家安全审查，未获豁免前30天（可延至4个月）内不得完成投资，而非设定持股比例封顶
foreign_ownership_limit.en: No blanket foreign-ownership percentage cap on listed companies; under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act (FEFTA), foreign investors acquiring 1% or more of a listed company operating in a "Core Business Sector" (e.g. semiconductors, defense equipment, cybersecurity) must submit a prior notification and clear a national-security review, with a 30-day (extendable to four months) investment-prohibition period — this is a notification/screening threshold, not an ownership ceiling
foreign_ownership_limit.detail: 「1%」是触发事前申报义务的门槛，不是禁止超过的上限；审查方向是国家安全而非产业保护式的外资限权。

sources.title: Foreign investors are required to submit a prior notification（MOF官网，制度概述PDF，2023年5月版）

foreign_ownership_limit.quote: Acquiring 1% or more of stocks of a listed company ... the foreign investors must submit a prior notification via a resident in Japan acting as an agent ... the foreign investor cannot make the investment or take similar actions within 30 days after the ministers receiving the prior notification. This period is called "investment prohibition period" and could be extended to four months.

capital_controls.zh: 1998年修订后的《外汇及外国贸易法》已全面放开跨境资本交易（原则自由）；此后叠加的唯一实质性管制层是FEFTA对「核心业务领域」外资并购的国家安全事前申报制度（见foreign_ownership_limit），而非传统意义的外汇/资本流动限制
capital_controls.en: The 1998 revision of the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act totally liberalized cross-border capital transactions in principle; the only substantive control layer added since is FEFTA's national-security prior-notification regime for foreign acquisitions in "Core Business Sectors" (see foreign_ownership_limit), not a traditional FX/capital-flow restriction
capital_controls.detail: 两份来源合并使用：Big Bang改革说明确认1998年资本项目自由化的历史背景；FEFTA说明页确认现行审查制度的性质是国家安全导向而非资本管制导向。

disclosure_requirements.zh: 以《有价证券上市规程》第402条「适时披露」为核心：上市公司发生对投资者决策有重大影响的事项须立即披露；决算须逐季（含累计季度）结算后立即披露财务业绩；披露一律通过交易所运营的TDnet系统向QUICK、路透、彭博等信息商同步分发，2025年4月起主板（Prime）上市的境内公司须日英双语同步披露决算与适时披露信息
disclosure_requirements.en: Centered on Rule 402 ("Timely Disclosure") of the Securities Listing Regulations: a listed company must disclose immediately any matter likely to have a significant impact on investors' decisions; quarterly (cumulative) earnings must be disclosed immediately once settled (Rule 404); disclosure is carried out through the Exchange's TDnet system for simultaneous dissemination to information vendors such as QUICK, Jiji Press, FactSet and Bloomberg (Rule 414); from April 2025 domestic Prime Market issuers must disclose financial results and timely-disclosure information simultaneously in Japanese and English
disclosure_requirements.detail: TDnet为强制披露渠道之一（Rule 414也允许书面通知等替代方式，仅在系统故障等例外情形使用）；双语同步义务目前仅覆盖Prime市场境内公司，Standard/Growth市场暂不强制。

investor_protection.zh: 日本投资者保护基金（JIPF，1998年12月依据《金融商品交易法》设立的会员制法人）：证券公司须与自有资产分离管理客户资产（客户资产分离保管制度）为第一道防线；若证券公司因破产等原因无法返还客户资产，JIPF对每位客户最高赔付1000万日元；截至2025财年末基金余额约584亿日元；成立以来仅两次实际赔付（2000年南证券、2012年丸大证券）
investor_protection.en: Japan Investor Protection Fund (JIPF), a nonprofit membership corporation established December 1, 1998 under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act: securities firms must keep customer assets segregated from their own as the first line of protection; if a firm cannot return customer cash/securities (e.g. due to bankruptcy), JIPF compensates up to ¥10 million per customer; the Fund balance was approximately ¥58.4 billion at the end of fiscal 2025; JIPF has paid compensation in only two cases since its founding (Minami Securities, 2000; Marudai Securities, 2012)

execution_model.zh: 订单驱动：TSE arrowhead 为全电子化中央订单簿，价格优先、时间优先连续竞价；现货股票市场没有场内指定做市商。仅交易所交易基金（ETF）设有『ETF 做市激励制度』——按品种指定做市商并要求持续双边报价
execution_model.en: Order-driven: TSE arrowhead is a fully electronic central order book matching on price then time priority; the cash equity market has no on-exchange designated market makers. Only ETFs have an 'ETF Market Making Incentive Scheme' under which market makers are designated per issue and required to post continuous two-sided quotes
execution_model.detail: enum 依据既有 matching_principle（Rule 10，价格-时间优先，confidence high）+ Rule 69（ETF 做市激励制度）综合判定：现货股票为纯订单驱动，ETF 的做市为激励型附加、不改变市场基本形态，故 order_driven（非 hybrid）。dealer_intermediated 记 false（就现货股票主市场而言）。

circuit_breaker.zh: 无独立的全市场熔断机制（如美股MWCB）；波动控制主要通过「特別気配」（特别行情揭示）机制实现——申报价格超出值幅制限的基准价时，不直接成交，而是显示特别气配指示性价格，上午盘超出即不成交，下午盘则按值幅制限价位处理
circuit_breaker.en: No separate market-wide circuit breaker (unlike the U.S. MWCB); volatility control operates primarily through the "special quote" mechanism — when an order price would exceed the price-limit band around the base price, no trade is executed at that price; instead a special indicative quote is displayed. In the morning session no transaction is effected; in the afternoon session trading is capped at the price limit
circuit_breaker.detail: 本条描述的是个股级机制，是否存在独立于值幅制限之外的全市场级熔断安排未在本次抓取内容中确认，留待后续核实，见 OPEN-QUESTIONS。

spec.note: TSE 業務規程 Rule 13：因误单产生的成交，只有在『极难完成交收且交易所认为市场可能混乱』时交易所才可作废（另有系统记录丢失情形）——无固定申请时限、无固定价格偏离阈值，是交易所裁量的窄口径例外，非常规复核流程。被作废的成交视同从未发生；下单方对因作废受损的对手方不负赔偿责任（故意 / 重大过失除外）。日本市场以『成交原则上不可撤销』著称，事前靠值幅制限 + 特別気配抑制误单成交

error_trade_rule.zh: TSE《业务规程》的「成交作废」条款：因误单产生的成交，仅在『交收极为困难且交易所认为市场可能陷入混乱』时，交易所方可作废该笔成交（另有系统交易记录因不可抗力丢失且难以恢复的情形）。无固定申请时限、无固定价格偏离百分比门槛——属交易所裁量的窄口径例外，而非常规错误交易复核流程。被作废成交视同自始未成立；下单方对因作废受损的对手方原则上不负赔偿责任（故意或重大过失除外）
error_trade_rule.en: TSE Business Regulations' transaction-cancellation rule: a transaction resulting from an erroneous order may be cancelled by the Exchange only where it is extremely difficult to conduct settlement and the Exchange deems the market likely to be confused (also where system transaction records are lost through unavoidable causes). There is no fixed application deadline and no fixed price-deviation threshold — this is a narrow, discretionary exception rather than a routine erroneous-trade review. A cancelled transaction is deemed never to have been effected; the party that placed the erroneous order is generally not liable to the counterparty for resulting damage (absent deliberate action or gross negligence)
error_trade_rule.detail: TSE Business Regulations Rule 13（Cancellation of Transactions）。与欧美的偏离阈值 + 时限式明显错误复核制度对比鲜明：日本现货成交近乎不可作废，事前防线是值幅制限（见 price_limits）与特別気配。deviation_threshold_pct / review_window_min 均留 null（原文无量化门槛）。

block_trade.zh: ToSTNeT（东证交易网络系统）为东证的场外（off-auction）大宗交易平台：ToSTNeT-1 含单一个股交易（最低 1 个交易单位，通常 100 股）与篮子交易（须 15 只以上标的、合计 1 亿日元以上）；ToSTNeT-2 为收盘价／VWAP 交易；ToSTNeT-3 为上市公司回购自家股份。ToSTNeT-1／-2 交易时段 8:20-18:00，按价格／数量一致即成交、不进入连续竞价订单簿

ToSTNeT-1/-2 trade 8:20 a.m.-6:00 p.m., matching on exact price/quantity correspondence outside the continuous auction book
block_trade.detail: 单一个股 ToSTNeT 交易的最低量按 Business Regulations Rule 15『交易单位』确定（即无『大额』硬门槛，其大宗属性来自协议成交、不冲击连续竞价簿）；篮子交易的 15 只 + 1 亿日元门槛见 ToSTNeT 特别规程施行细则 Rule 3。ToSTNeT-1 于 1998-06-29 上线（1999-09-30 前称『大口交易』），ToSTNeT-2 于 1999-08-07 上线。

order_book_transparency.zh: 盘前：TSE arrowhead 为公开的中央订单簿，各价位的申报数量以『板情報』向市场披露；价格急剧变动时以『特別気配』（special quote）显示预期成交价并放缓成交。现货股票订单簿不提供冰山 / 隐藏限价单类型（全部申报数量公开）。盘后 / 大宗：立会外取引 ToSTNeT 单独进行并披露。适用日本金商法的成交披露要求
order_book_transparency.en: Pre-trade: TSE arrowhead is a public central order book; order quantities at each price level are disseminated as board information (板情報), and a 'special quote' (特別気配) is displayed to signal the expected execution price and slow matching during sharp moves. The cash equity order book does not offer iceberg or hidden order types — full order quantities are shown. Off-auction / block trades run separately on ToSTNeT and are disclosed. Trade publication follows the requirements of Japan's Financial Instruments and Exchange Act
order_book_transparency.detail: 字段管本所订单簿内部的（非）展示流动性；ToSTNeT 立会外系统见 block_trade。TSE 现货订单簿无非展示订单类型是与欧美市场的一个显著差异。quote 复用 matching_principle / circuit_breaker 已核实的板情報·特別気配措辞；整体 confidence: medium（盘后披露延迟参数未逐字核实）。

dark_pool.zh: 东证（TSE）本身不运营暗池；ToSTNeT 为场外申报成交（见 block_trade），非非展示撮合。日本的场外场所是《金融商品交易法》(FIEA) 下的『私设交易系统』（PTS）。2025 年 8 月底 Cboe Japan（原 Chi-X Japan，2021 年收购进入）终止 PTS 业务后，日本已无独立的多边 PTS——TSE 实际上成为唯一汇集广泛券商订单的多边撮合场所；其余为券商内部化 PTS 与自营暗池（SBI 证券 2024-04 上线的『SBI Cross』、乐天证券的『R-Cross』），SBI Japannext 亦属 SBI 关联的 PTS。信用交易依 FSA 规则不得在暗池执行。PTS 份额约由 2021 年 8.8% 升至 2025 上半年 12.2%，暗池由 3.1% 升至 5.0%
dark_pool.en: TSE itself operates no dark pool; ToSTNeT is off-auction reported trading (see block_trade), not non-displayed matching. Japan's off-exchange venues are Proprietary Trading Systems (PTS) under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (FIEA). After Cboe Japan (formerly Chi-X Japan, which entered via acquisition in 2021) terminated its PTS at the end of August 2025, no independent multilateral PTS remains — TSE has effectively become the only multilateral venue matching a wide range of brokers' orders; the rest are broker-internalized PTS and proprietary dark pools (SBI Securities' 'SBI Cross', launched April 2024; Rakuten Securities' 'R-Cross'), with SBI Japannext also an SBI-affiliated PTS. Margin trades cannot legally execute in dark pools under FSA rules. PTS market share rose from ~8.8% (2021) to 12.2% (H1 2025), dark pools from 3.1% to 5.0%
dark_pool.detail: 本字段『本所自营暗池』一栏 jp-jpx 为『无』。引文取自日本証券経済研究所（JSRI）2025-11 报告——JSRI 是证券业研究机构，按 CLAUDE.md 二第3条 confidence 封顶 medium。PTS 运营须 FIEA 第一种金融商品取引业许可、并受市场份额上限（历史约每股 10% / 全市场 20%）约束，此项细则本次未逐字缓存。

sources.title: JSRI — The Implications of Cboe Japan's Withdrawal: Structural Changes in Japan's Stock Market（Manabu Morimoto, 2025-11）

dark_pool.quote: At the end of August, Cboe Japan terminated its PTS—equivalent to the United States' ATS—operations in Japan. …… With Cboe Japan's withdrawal, there are no longer any independent PTSs in Japan. This means that TSE has effectively become the only multilateral venue matching orders from a wide range of broker-dealers. …… Currently, SBI Securities and Rakuten Securities execute margin trades primarily on internalized PTSs and cash equity trades through dark pools because margin trading cannot legally be executed in dark pools under FSA rules. …… began executing its own orders in its proprietary dark pool called "SBI Cross" (in April). Rakuten Securities had already been executing through its own dark pool ("R-Cross") …… PTS and dark pool market shares have risen sharply (from 8.8% → 12.2% for PTSs and 3.1% → 5.0% for dark pools between 2021 and 2025 (Jan–Jun))

matching_principle.zh: 价格优先、时间优先：期货与期权按 individual auction（个别竞价）进行——常规时段（Zaraba）内在最低卖价与最高买价相等的价位、按价格与时间优先原则于撮合申报间成交；Itayose 集合竞价同样按价格/时间优先规则确定使成交量最大的价格，市价单另按接单时间优先参与
matching_principle.en: Price-time priority: futures and options trade by individual auction — in the regular session (Zaraba), transactions execute among matching orders according to the price and time priority rule at a price where the lowest offer and the highest bid are matched; the Itayose call auction also determines the volume-maximizing price under the price and time priority rule, with market orders prioritized by acceptance time

order_types.zh: 限价单与市价单两类；市价单未成交部分不得留存于订单簿（强制撤销），故不保证全部成交。下单须择一指定有效期/数量条件：GFD（当日有效）、GTD/GTC（指定日前/撤销前有效）、FAK（部分成交后撤销未成部分）、FOK（未即时全部成交即全撤）；另有跨期价差与跨商品价差策略交易（收盘集合竞价期间不可用）与带平仓条件订单（须指定 pre-closing 段）
order_types.en: Limit orders and market orders; the unfilled part of a market order cannot be stored on the order book (forced cancellation), so market orders are not guaranteed to fill. One validity/volume condition must be specified: GFD, GTD/GTC, FAK (cancel unfilled volume after partial execution) or FOK (cancel all unless executed immediately in full); calendar spread and inter-commodity spread strategy trading is available (not during the closing auction), alongside orders with closing conditions (which must specify a pre-closing session)

order_types.quote: Limit Order An order submitted with a specified limit price and to be executed at the specified price or better price. Market Order An order submitted without the specified limit price and to be executed against the best bid or the best offer in order.* The unfilled part of a market order cannot be stored on the order book (the unfilled part is forced to be cancelled). ／ Good for Day (GFD) Valid until the end of the Day Session of the day (or, until the end of the Night Session if the order is submitted at the Night Session.). ／ Fill and Kill (FAK) In the case where there is unfilled volume after the order is partially executed, cancel the unfilled volume. Fill or Kill (FOK) In the case where all the volume is not executed immediately, cancel all the volume. ／ Calendar Spreads and Inter-Commodity Spreads are available.

circuit_breaker.zh: SCB（Static Circuit Breaker）：当中央限月期货（触发判定不含 mini/micro 合约）的涨跌停价位出现买入（卖出）申报或成交时，暂停该标的全限月期货（含 mini、micro 与 Rolling-Spot）、同标的全部期权、相关策略交易及其 J-NET 交易——暂停时长 10 分钟以上，并以扩幅后的价格限制以 Itayose 方式复牌；触发条件在日盘/夜盘常规时段结束前 20 分钟以内满足时不适用
circuit_breaker.en: SCB (Static Circuit Breaker): when a buy (sell) order is placed or executed at the upper (lower) price limit for the central contract month of a futures contract (trigger test excluding mini/micro contracts), trading is suspended across all contract months of the same underlying (including mini, micro and Rolling-Spot contracts), all options on the same underlying, related strategy trades and their J-NET trading — for more than 10 minutes, with resumption by the Itayose method under expanded price limits; the rule does not apply where the criteria are met within 20 minutes before the end of the regular session

sources.title: Price Limits/ Circuit Breaker Rule（JPX官网英文版，SCB 节）

circuit_breaker.quote: In the case where a buy (sell) order is placed (or executed) at the upper (lower) price limit for the central contract month of a futures contract (excluding mini contracts and micro contracts), the trading of futures whose underlying is the same as this central contract month (including mini contracts, micro contracts and Rolling-Spot contracts) will be suspended and the upper (lower) daily price limit range will be expanded. ／ All future contract months All option contracts which have the same underlying The strategy trades related to (1) J-NET trading of (1) and (2) ／ More than 10 minutes ／ After the duration for a trading halt, trading will be resumed by the Itayose method with the price limit expanded. ／ In the case where the above criteria is met within 20 minutes before the end of the regular session of the day (afternoon) or night session.
circuit_breaker.detail:
enum 借用 stock_level 表「非全市场」含义（受控词表 circuit_breaker_type 无「产品线/同标的整组」档位，见 OPEN-QUESTIONS #44(b) 惯例）：
OSE 的 SCB 触发颗粒度是「中央限月期货触及涨跌停」这一合约级事件，但暂停范围覆盖同标的全组产品——既非单合约暂停、
也非指数点位触发的全市场熔断。另注：TAIEX 期货与橡胶/农产品商品期货不适用 SCB；触发时点由 OSE 逐案确定（略有延迟）。

volatility_interruption.zh: DCB（Immediately Executable Price Range Rule，立即执行价格区间规则）：以最新成交价（LTP）为基准 ±0.8% 的价格区间，撮合价越出区间即触发临时中止并转 Itayose 冷静；开盘/收盘集合竞价的区间分别放宽至 ±3.0% 与 ±1.5%；冷静期经过后若撮合价仍在区间外，则将基准价更新至区间内最接近的报价单位继续暂停，回到区间内则以 Itayose 复牌
volatility_interruption.en: DCB (Immediately Executable Price Range Rule): a price band of ±0.8% around the last traded price (LTP); a match outside the band triggers a temporary halt and an Itayose cooling period; the band is wider for the opening and closing auctions (±3.0% and ±1.5% respectively); if after the set duration the matching price is still outside the band, the reference price is updated to the closest tick within the band and the halt continues — trading resumes by Itayose once the price is back inside

sources.title: Nikkei 225 Futures Contract Specifications（JPX官网英文版，DCB 节）

volatility_interruption.quote: Immediately Executable Price Range Rule(DCB)：LTP ±0.8% ※However, the DCB Price Range for Opening Auction and Closing Auction will be ±3.0% and ±1.5% respectively.
volatility_interruption.detail:
机制全貌摘自 Immediately Executable Price Range Rule 页：官方明言 DCB「similar to special quotation mechanism in stock market」（与现货特別気配同源），
且冷静期时长为「a set duration of time」（脚注1，页内未给数值）。各产品线区间不同（如 TOPIX 期权按基准价水平分档 ±2.5 至 ±25 点、
JGB 为绝对额档），见 pricerange 页分档表；本字段 spec.dynamic_pct 取旗舰日经225期货常规时段值。

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 除 SCB/DCB 自动机制外，交易所保有裁量性不停市判断——即使触发条件满足，交易所若认为停牌不妥亦可不中止交易；JGB/利率期货在上午段结束前 10 分钟以内触发熔断的，上午段停止交易但以扩幅区间照常进行上午段收盘 Itayose。个股/合约因重大消息等的裁量停牌条款本次未在大阪取引所业务规程中另行检索
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Beyond the automatic SCB/DCB mechanisms, the Exchange retains discretion not to halt — even where trigger criteria are met, trading will not be suspended if the Exchange deems a trading suspension inappropriate in view of trading conditions; for JGB/interest rate futures, where the circuit breaker is triggered within 10 minutes of the morning session's end, the morning session is halted but its closing auction is still conducted with the expanded price limit. Discretionary halt provisions for individual contracts on material news were not separately retrieved from the OSE business regulations this session

sources.title: Price Limits/ Circuit Breaker Rule（JPX官网英文版，SCB 例外与 JGB 上午段处理）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: In cases where the Exchange deems that a trading suspension would not be appropriate in consideration of the trading conditions, etc. ／ In cases where the circuit breaker is triggered 10 minutes or less before the end of the morning session of JGB Futures and Interest Rate Futures, the trading in the morning session shall be halted, but the closing auction of the morning session would be conducted with the price limit expanded.
trading_halt_mechanism.detail:
本字段为 medium：引用的两段均属 SCB 框架内的例外/特例条款，能支撑「交易所裁量」与「上午段收盘 Itayose 照常进行」两点；

block_trade.zh: J-NET 交易为大阪取引所竞价市场之外的场外期货/期权交易平台：单一品种交易（与指定对手方就对手方、品种、价格、数量等报价要素撮合成交）、灵活单一品种交易（Flexible Futures/Options——SQ 日、最终结算方式等条件可协商）、头寸压缩交易（Compression，压降指数期货/期权头寸）；指数期货/期权的 J-NET 时段为 8:20-16:30 与 16:45-6:00（次日）；日经225期货在 J-NET 内最小报价单位 0.0001 日元、最小交易单位 1 单位
block_trade.en: J-NET Trading is OSE's off-auction futures and options platform independent of the auction market: J-NET Single Issue Trading (executed when price quotations — counterparty, issue, price, volume, etc. — match against a designated counterparty), Flexible Single Issue Trading (Flexible Futures/Options — SQ date, final settlement method etc. negotiable) and Compression Trading (position reduction in index futures/options); J-NET hours for index futures/options are 8:20-16:30 and 16:45-6:00 (following day); Nikkei 225 Futures on J-NET tick at JPY 0.0001 with a minimum trading unit of 1 unit

block_trade.quote: J-NET Derivatives Trading refers to off-auction futures and options trading in the J-NET market which is in independent of the auction market on Osaka Exchange. ／ J-NET Single Issue Trading Investors can trade with a designated couterparty. The order will be executed when the price quotations (counterparty, issue, price, and volume, etc.) match. ／ Index Futures (except for Nikkei 225 VI Futures) / Index Options 8:20～16:30 16:45～6:00 (following day)

margin_practice_note.zh: 期货与期权保证金按 VaR 法计算（参数文件、模拟环境等细则由 JSCC 公布）；期货买卖双方均须缴纳保证金，期权卖方须缴纳、期权买方潜在损失以权利金为限故无须缴纳；客户实际保证金由各证券公司计算，且不得低于 JSCC 公布的每单位最低保证金额（Price Scan Range）
margin_practice_note.en: Margin requirements for futures and options are calculated by the VaR method (parameter files, simulation environment and other details published by JSCC); both buyer and seller must post margin in futures trading, while in options trading the seller posts margin but the buyer does not — the buyer's potential loss is limited to the premium; actual customer margin is calculated by each brokerage firm and must be at least the Price Scan Range (minimum margin per unit) published by JSCC

margin_practice_note.quote: Margin requirements for futures and options are calculated based on VaR method. Please refer to the JSCC website for details of VaR method such as parameter files, simulation environment and other related issues. ／ However, in cases where the market moves against the forecasts of an options buyer, potential losses would be limited to only the premium. As such, a margin deposit would not be required.

After listing approval by TSE, about one month will be required for public offering procedures (the IPO). An applicant therefore needs four months, as a rule, from the listing application date to the first day of listing.

transfer_between_boards.zh: 东证板块间转移制度：TSE 现行设 Prime（主板）/ Standard / Growth 三个市场板块（2022-04-04 起施行，市场再编的结果）；上市公司可申请转移其上市股票所属市场板块——《有价证券上市规程》第3章第2节「Transfer of Market Segments」（Rule 306–310）专门规定板块转移，板块转移申请准用首次上市的资格审查条款（Rule 308：转板 Standard Market 准用 Rule 205/206/207）
transfer_between_boards.en: TSE operates a market-segment transfer regime: TSE currently has three market segments — Prime, Standard and Growth (in effect since 4 April 2022 as the outcome of the market restructuring); a listed company may apply to transfer the market segment of its listed stock — the Securities Listing Regulations Chapter 3 Section 2 'Transfer of Market Segments' (Rules 306–310) governs such transfers, with the initial-listing qualification provisions applied mutatis mutandis to a transfer application to the Standard Market (Rule 308)

transfer_between_boards.quote: TSE carried out research into a possible market restructuring, and started three market segments, the "Prime Market", "Standard Market", and "Growth Market", on April 4, 2022. ... The provisions of Rule 205 (excluding Items (5) and (7)), Rule 206 (excluding Paragraph 2, Item (2)), and Rule 207, Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 5 shall be applied mutatis mutandis to the cases where an application for transfer of a market segment to the Standard Market is made pursuant to the provisions of Rule 306.

continuing_obligations.zh: 上市公司持续义务的两大支柱：其一，公司治理报告（Corporate Governance Report）——须以交易所规定格式披露公司治理状况并保持信息更新，交易所在网站集中公开以便投资者横向比较；其二，适时披露义务的持续履行（见disclosure_requirements），任何影响投资者决策的重大事项须持续、即时披露，不因上市完成而终止
continuing_obligations.en: Two pillars of continuing obligations: (1) the Corporate Governance Report — listed companies must disclose their corporate governance status in a TSE-prescribed format and keep it updated whenever changes occur, made centrally available on the JPX website for cross-company comparison; (2) the ongoing performance of the timely-disclosure duty (see disclosure_requirements) — the duty to disclose material information immediately continues indefinitely after listing, not just at the IPO stage

Securities Listing Regulations（TSE官网英文版PDF）Rule 419

continuing_obligations.quote: TSE decided to collect corporate governance-related information in the form of reports from each company and make this available to view at any time in one place, on the TSE website. / Where there has occurred any change in the information in a report including the matters regarding corporate governance specified by the Enforcement Rules ... a listed company shall submit a report after the change without delay.

suspension_resumption.zh: 交易所可依《业务规程》第29条对个股实施停牌，情形包括：涉及证券或发行人、可能对投资者决策有重大影响的信息已披露但细节尚不明朗；交易状态异常或从监管角度不宜继续交易；交易系统故障等。停牌时长视具体事项而定，实践中多数个股停牌（如并购、公开发行公告）在停牌当日内数十分钟至数小时后即恢复交易；此外第4/5条允许交易所在必要时对整个交易时段临时全体停牌或加开时段，并须提前通知交易参与者
suspension_resumption.en: Under Rule 29 of the Business Regulations, the Exchange may halt trading in a security where: information likely to have a significant effect on investors' decisions has emerged but its details remain unclear; the state of trading is deemed abnormal or continuing trading is inappropriate from a supervisory standpoint; or a trading-system malfunction occurs. Duration varies by case — most individual-issue halts (e.g. merger or public-offering announcements) resume within tens of minutes to a few hours the same day per the Exchange's own halt records; separately, Rules 4/5 let the Exchange temporarily halt or extend a trading session market-wide when necessary, with advance notice to trading participants

Trading Halts（JPX官网，个股停牌实时记录）

Where information on a certain security or issuer that may have a significant effect on investors' investment decisions is revealed and details of such information are not clear and/or the Exchange deems it necessary to make details aware to the public ... Rule 4. Temporary Halt and Temporary Conducting of Trading Session / The Exchange may temporarily halt a trading session in whole or in part or temporarily conduct an additional trading session in whole or in part, when it deems this necessary.

delisting_conditions.zh: 退市标准（三板块通用，《有价证券上市规程》Rule 601 第1项第1–20号，官方概要页）：触及持续上市标准（股东数、成交量、市值、净资产等）原则上经 1 年宽限（成交量为 6 个月）后退市——触及后 3 个月内须提交达标改善计划；有价证券报告书迟延提交、内部管理体系失效、反社会势力关联等情形亦构成退市事由
delisting_conditions.en: Delisting criteria (common to all market segments — Securities Listing Regulations Rule 601, Paragraph 1, Items 1 through 20, per JPX's official outline): failure to meet the Continued Listing Criteria (shareholders, trading volume, market cap, net assets, etc.) leads to delisting after a one-year grace period (six months for trading volume) in principle, with an improvement plan due within three months; delay in filing securities reports, breakdown of internal management systems, anti-social-forces involvement and other grounds also trigger delisting

sources.title: Outline of Delisting Criteria（JPX 官网，退市标准概要与宽限程序）

delisting_conditions.quote: Delisting Criteria (Common for All Market Segments) A listed company which falls under any of the following shall be delisted. (Rule 601, Paragraph 1, Items 1 through 20 of the Securities Listing Regulations) ... A listed company shall be delisted after one year (six months in the case of the trading volume of the Continued Listing Criteria) (*), in principle, has passed since the listed company has fallen short of conforming to the Continued Listing Criteria.

delisting_process.zh: 退市流程分四步：①退市申请（公司主动申请退市须提交指定退市申请表，Rule 606）；②在决定退市前，若某证券有可能被退市，交易所可将其指定为「监理股份」（Securities Under Supervision）以提示投资者（Rule 608）；③一旦决定退市，交易所将其指定为「整理股份」（Securities to Be Delisted），指定持续至退市日前一天（Rule 609）；④退市日当天从上市证券登记簿中注销（Rule 610）。因未达持续上市标准而触发的退市，另有一年（交易量类指标为六个月）整改期，整改期内须提交并汇报整改计划（见delisting_transition_period）
delisting_process.en: Delisting follows four steps: (1) Delisting Application — a company voluntarily delisting must submit the prescribed application form (Rule 606); (2) before delisting is decided, the Exchange may designate a security likely to be delisted as "Securities Under Supervision" to alert investors (Rule 608); (3) once delisting is decided, the Exchange designates the security as "Securities to be Delisted" for the period until the day before the delisting date (Rule 609); (4) on the delisting date the Exchange erases the security from the listed security registry (Rule 610). Delisting triggered by failing to meet Continued Listing Criteria carries a separate one-year (six months for trading-volume criteria) improvement period during which the company must disclose and report on a conformance plan (see delisting_transition_period)

sources.title: Securities Listing Regulations（TSE官网英文版PDF）Rule 606-610

delisting_process.quote: Rule 606. Delisting Application ... Rule 608. Designation of Securities Under Supervision / Where a listed stock, etc. is likely to be delisted, the Exchange may designate such listed stock, etc. as a security under supervision to make investors aware of that fact ... Rule 609. Designation of Securities to be Delisted / Where a listed stock, etc. is decided to be delisted, the Exchange may designate such listed stock, etc. as a security to be delisted for a period until the day before the delisting date ... Rule 610. Erasure from the Registry / Where the Exchange delists a listed stock, etc., it shall delete descriptions in the listed security registry on the delisting date.

post_delisting_venue.en: No official post-delisting venue exists: under Securities Listing Regulations Rule 610, upon delisting the Exchange deletes the stock from the listed security registry on the delisting date — the regulations provide no successor listing venue or taking-over mechanism; delisted shares simply become unlisted (whether any off-exchange mechanism in Japan takes over delisted stocks was outside this review scope — see detail)

initial_margin_practice.zh: JSCC 要求现物清算参加者预缴『当初保证金』（当初証拠金）以覆盖现物交易的风险暴露，由两部分构成：①未决清算约定按最新市场价格评估的值洗价值（時価評価額）；②按历史模拟法 VaR 计算的假定损失额（持有期间 1 日、参照期间 250 日、置信水平 99%）。市场压力期下若参加者破产的预期损失超出预缴财务资源可覆盖的额度，JSCC 可上调相关参加者的当初保证金所要额；另设按信用状况的割增制度。2026-06-30 时点全体清算参加者的当初保证金所要额合计 1,688 億円
initial_margin_practice.en: JSCC requires cash clearing participants to lodge initial margin covering their cash-market exposure, comprising: (1) the mark-to-market value of unsettled trades evaluated at the latest market price; and (2) the hypothetical loss calculated by historical simulation VaR (1-day holding period, 250-day lookback, 99% confidence level). In stressed markets, where the loss expected from a participant's default would exceed the prefunded financial resources, JSCC raises the initial margin requirement of the participants bearing that risk; a surcharge based on credit standing also applies. Total initial margin required of all clearing participants stood at 168.8 billion yen as of 30 June 2026

sources.title: JSCC 現物取引 証拠金（JPX 官网 JSCC 栏目官方页，当初証拠金构成/压力期上调/割增制度/所要额）

initial_margin_practice.quote: JSCCでは、現物取引に係るエクスポージャーをカバーするために、現物清算参加者に対して以下の構成要素に基づき算出された当初証拠金の預託を求めています。 未決済約定を直近の市場価格で評価した値洗い価値（時価評価額） 未決済約定の時価評価額と各銘柄の価格変動（保有期間1日、参照期間250日、信頼水準99％）に基づいてヒストリカルシミュレーション（VaR）方式によって計算される想定損失額 ... 市場ストレス期において清算参加者が破綻した場合に想定される損失額が、現物取引に関し清算参加者から預託されている事前拠出型の財務資源をもっても補填しえない額となる場合、当該未補填額を予めカバーすべく、当該リスクを有する清算参加者に対する当初証拠金所要額を引き上げることとしております。 ... 2026年6月30日現在の全清算参加者の当初証拠金所要額は1,688億円。

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: JSCC 不设与初始保证金分离的『维持保证金』阈值——替代机制是逐日重算的当初保证金要求，辅以两项动态加收安排：①信用状况割增——清算参加者的信用状况经判断有必要时对其当初保证金割增；②日中預託——TOPIX 或日经平均期货中心限月上午 11 时约定数值与前交易日清算数值之差超过当初保证金日中預託发动基准值时发动盘中追加预缴（仅当按当日午盘未决约定计算的所要额较最近适用额高出 3,000 万円以上时适用）
maintenance_margin_practice.en: JSCC has no separate maintenance margin threshold distinct from initial margin — the daily recalculated initial margin requirement is supplemented by two dynamic add-on arrangements: (1) a surcharge where JSCC deems necessary in light of a clearing participant's credit standing; and (2) intraday margin lodging triggered when the difference in TOPIX or Nikkei 225 futures central contract month trading values at 11:00 a.m. versus the previous day's clearing values exceeds the intraday trigger threshold (applicable only where the requirement calculated on that morning's unsettled trades exceeds the most recently applied requirement by more than 30 million yen)

sources.title: JSCC 現物取引 証拠金（JPX 官网 JSCC 栏目官方页，割増し制度与日中預託制度）

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: ＜当初証拠金の割増し制度＞ 信用状況に応じた割増し JSCCでは、清算参加者の信用状況に鑑みて必要と認める場合には、当初証拠金の割増しを行います。 ＜当初証拠金の日中預託制度＞ 急激な相場変動に伴う割増し JSCCでは、以下のいずれかの基準に該当した場合、当初証拠金の日中預託を発動します。 ... 当日の午前立会終了時点の未決済約定に基づき計算された当初証拠金所要額が直近に適用されている当初証拠金所要額を3,000万円より上回っている場合に限り適用されます。

mark_to_market_frequency.zh: 按日盯市、日内补充：当初保证金的构成之一即未决清算约定按最新市场价格评估的值洗价值（時価評価額）——对未交收头寸逐日按市价重估；市场剧烈波动时另设日中（盘中）触发——TOPIX 或日经平均期货中心限月上午 11 时约定数值与前交易日清算数值之差超过当初保证金日中預託发动基准值时，发动盘中追加预缴
mark_to_market_frequency.en: Daily mark-to-market with an intraday supplement: a component of the initial margin is the mark-to-market value of unsettled trades evaluated at the latest market price — unsettled positions are re-valued to market daily; under sharp market moves, an intraday trigger applies — when the difference in TOPIX or Nikkei 225 futures central contract month trading values at 11:00 a.m. versus the previous day's clearing values exceeds the intraday lodging trigger threshold, intraday margin lodging is activated

spec.note: JSCC 宣告违约后停止为违约方清算新交易、在市场对冲平仓其持仓，客户持仓与担保品在可行时转移给非违约会员；违约损失依 JSCC 损失补偿（清算基金等）财务资源规则消化，并维持流动性供应设施按既定时间表完成结算。所抓官方页描述处置流程而非逐层损失分摊瀑布 → 三态占位为 unstructured

default_management.zh: JSCC（清算机构）持续监控清算参与者以避免违约；一旦其管理层判定某参与者已经或可能无法履行义务，即宣告违约，随即停止为其清算新交易并处置其持仓——上市产品的处置方式为在市场上做对冲平仓交易；客户持仓与担保品在可行情况下可转移给未违约的清算参与者；违约造成的损失依JSCC自身的损失补偿（清算基金等）财务资源规则消化；即使发生违约，JSCC仍按既定时间表完成结算，为此维持流动性供应设施
default_management.en: JSCC (the CCP) continuously monitors Clearing Participants to avoid defaults; if its senior management determines a participant is, or is likely to be, unable to perform its obligations, JSCC declares a default, halts clearing of new transactions from the defaulter, and liquidates the defaulter's positions — for listed products, by offsetting transactions in the market. Customer positions and collateral can, where feasible, be transferred (ported) to non-defaulting Clearing Participants. Losses arising from the default process are absorbed using JSCC's loss-compensation financial resources per its rules; even when a default occurs, JSCC still fulfills settlement on the regular schedule, maintaining Liquidity Supply Facilities for this purpose

default_management.quote: JSCC will declare that a Clearing Participant is in default if such participant is, or is likely to be, unable to perform its obligations, according to the determination of JSCC's senior management. If a default is declared, JSCC can take actions to contain losses by halting clearing of new transactions from the defaulter and liquidating the defaulter's positions. ... Even when a Clearing Participant default occurs, JSCC will fulfill settlement according to the regular schedule.

initial_margin_practice.zh: JSCC 对各清算业务按与其适配的方法计算初始保证金，对所有产品以不低于 99% 的置信水平覆盖潜在未来风险暴露；上市衍生品的初始保证金采用 Expected Shortfall（历史模拟法）——参照期间 1,250 个营业日加压力期、持有期 2 个营业日、置信水平 99%、参数逐日更新
initial_margin_practice.en: JSCC calculates initial margin for each Clearing Business using a method appropriate for that business, covering potential future exposures for all products with a confidence level of at least 99%; for listed derivatives, initial margin uses Expected Shortfall (historical simulation) — a reference period of 1,250 business days plus a stress period, a holding period of 2 business days, 99% confidence level, with parameters updated daily

initial_margin_practice.detail:
本字段为清算端（CCP）保证金方法论视角，与 market_structure.derivatives.margin_practice_note（交易端要求）描述同一制度但视角不同，
不合并（[ADR-030]）。JSCC 另实施逆周期措施（APC Measures：额外压力情景、波动率下限、最低保证金要求等）以抑制顺周期性；
并逐账户逐日回测验证置信水平达成（向风险管理委员会月报、董事会/风险委员会季报）。
注：表注 *1 载明日经225分红点指数期货及部分商品衍生品仍用 VaR；*3 载明上市商品衍生品持有期为 1 个营业日。

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: 不设与初始保证金并立的固定「维持保证金」阈值——机制为逐日盯市后与清算参加者收付变动保证金（variation margin）、初始保证金要求逐日重算；官方英文页未见上市衍生品的盘中维持阈值触发安排说明（顶层 maintenance_margin_practice 所述日中預託制度的触发标的是 TOPIX/日经期货约定数值差，属现物保证金页表述）
maintenance_margin_practice.en: No fixed maintenance-margin threshold standing alongside initial margin — the mechanism is daily mark-to-market followed by variation margin exchange with Clearing Participants, with the initial margin requirement recalculated daily; no intraday maintenance-threshold trigger for listed derivatives is described on the official English page (the intraday lodging arrangement described at the top-level field is keyed to TOPIX/Nikkei futures trading-value differences per the cash-products margin page)

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: For listed derivatives, CDS, IRS, and OTC JGB, open positions are marked-to-market using the most recent price at least once a day, following which variation margin is exchanged with Clearing Participants.

The enum value `either` expresses the per-product-line split, not an optional choice per position

last_trading_day_rule.zh: 股指期货/期权最后交易日为各合约月份（期权为到期月份）第二个星期五前的工作日（第二个星期五为非营业日时为再前一个营业日）；新合约月份自最后交易日的次一营业日开始交易；SQ 日为最后交易日的次一营业日（最终结算价按该日构成股开盘价计算）；国债期货最后交易日为各交割日前的第五个营业日（交割日为合约月份第二十个自然日，遇非营业日顺延——日期细则见 detail）

account_opening_requirements.en: Before entrusting securities trading to a Trading Participant (broker), a customer must, under Rule 3 of the Brokerage Agreement Standards, notify the Trading Participant of: (1) personal or corporate name; (2) address or office location; (3) the name of a designated place to receive communications, if any; and (4) where an agent has been appointed, the agent's name, address, and scope of authority. Opening specific account types — such as a margin transaction account or a foreign securities trading account — requires signing the corresponding separate agreement

suitability_management.zh: 《金融商品交易法》第40条第1项确立「适合性原则」：金融商品交易业者不得进行鉴于客户知识、经验、财产状况及订立金融商品交易合同目的而被认定为不适当的劝诱。该原则包含「狭义适合性原则」（对特定客户完全不得劝诱销售特定商品，无论说明多详细）与「广义适合性原则」（劝诱方式须与客户知识/经验/财产状况相匹配），并延伸出订立合同前须按客户属性进行充分说明的义务；仅适用于「一般投资者」，对「专业投资者」原则上不适用，但一般投资者若被劝诱转为专业投资者，转换劝诱本身仍受适合性原则约束
suitability_management.en: Article 40(i) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act establishes the "principle of suitability": a business operator must not conduct sales/solicitation that is found to be inappropriate in light of the customer's knowledge, experience, financial situation, and purpose of concluding a financial instruments transaction contract. It comprises the "principle of suitability in the narrow sense" (a rule against soliciting certain instruments to specific users regardless of how detailed the explanation) and "in the broad sense" (solicitation must suit the user's knowledge/experience/property), extending into a pre-contract explanation obligation tailored to customer attributes; it applies to "General Investors" but not, in principle, to "Professional Investors" — though the act of soliciting a General Investor to become a Professional Investor is itself still subject to the suitability principle

sources.title: FAQ on Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, Section 6（金融厅FSA官网）

suitability_management.quote: While the principle of suitability (Article 40(i) of the FIEA) is not applied when making solicitation of transactions to Professional Investors, the principle will apply when General Investors shift their status to Professional Investors by choice. ... The principle of suitability is a principle that should constitute a pillar of sales/solicitation rules for protection of users ... there is the "principle of suitability in the narrow sense" (a rule that a business operator must not conduct sales/solicitation of certain instruments to specific users regardless of how much detailed explanation the business operator provides) and the "principle of suitability in the broad sense" (a rule that a business operator must conduct sales/solicitation in a way that suits the knowledge/experience/property, etc. of the users).

foreign_access_channel.en: Foreign investors access TSE mainly through two channels: (1) the same route as domestic investors — opening an account with a domestic Trading Participant (broker) to entrust trading (see account_opening_requirements); (2) overseas securities firms may themselves qualify as "Remote Trading Participants / Remote Broker Participants" and connect to the trading system directly — the List of Trading Participants already includes several such firms (e.g. Citadel Securities (Hong Kong), Susquehanna Hong Kong). Cross-border equity investment is separately subject to the FEFTA prior-notification regime (see capital_controls/foreign_ownership_limit), which is a national-security screening precondition on the investment itself, not a trading channel

major_outage_history.zh: 2020年10月1日，现货交易系统arrowhead发生故障：共享磁盘设备（Shared Disk Device）1号机内存模组故障，且未能按预期自动切换至2号机，TSE为此向投资者及市场相关方致歉并公开发布事件经过、故障原因与再发防止措施报告。TSE官方于10月5日公布直接原因（内存模组故障场景下自动切换功能未生效）及应对措施（10月4日已完成设备设置变更并确认切换功能恢复正常），并成立由市场参与者组成的「故障再发防止对策委员会」检讨规则与应对机制
major_outage_history.en: On October 1, 2020, the cash equity trading system arrowhead suffered a failure: a memory-module failure occurred in Device 1 of its Shared Disk Device, and automatic switchover to Device 2 did not function as expected; TSE apologized to investors and market participants and published a report on the sequence of events, cause, and recurrence-prevention measures. TSE published the direct cause on October 5 (automatic switching does not function for a memory-module-failure scenario) and the remedial measure (the device settings were changed on October 4 and switchover was confirmed working), and established a market-user "Council for Recurrence Prevention Measures" to review its rules and response
major_outage_history.detail: 多家第三方媒体（Reuters/FT等）当时报道此次故障导致TSE当天全天停市，是该所自1999年全面电子化交易以来首次全日停牌；但本次抓取的JPX官方新闻稿与10月5日官方报告原文均未在文本中明确出现「全日/whole day」这一表述，按铁律不把第三方转述的具体停市时长细节写进confidence:high的正文，仅在此说明。

commission_structure.zh: 「日本金融大爆炸」（Big Bang，1996年11月启动的金融体制改革）全面放开经纪佣金管制，此前长期实行固定费率；自由化后佣金转为各证券公司自行议定，并直接带动了网上交易（在线证券交易）的扩张，目前主流网上券商多提供极低或零佣金的现货股票交易服务（本次未抓取到某一家具体券商的费率表，故不展开列举具体数字）
commission_structure.en: Brokerage commissions were fully liberalized as part of Japan's "Big Bang" financial system reform (commenced November 1996), replacing the long-standing fixed-rate regime; since liberalization, commissions are freely negotiated between securities companies and customers, and this liberalization directly drove the expansion of online (internet) securities trading, with mainstream online brokers today commonly offering very low or zero-commission cash-equity trading (no single broker's current rate table was fetched this session, so no specific figure is asserted)
commission_structure.detail: 本条描述的是制度层面的「佣金已自由化」这一事实，不是任何一家具体券商的现行费率；后者随时间/券商变化快，不适合作为交易所层面的稳定事实记录。

commission_structure.quote: The Financial System Reform, "Japanese Big Bang," was commenced in November 1996 ... switching from the licensing system to a registration system for securities companies, liberalizing cross-border capital transactions and foreign exchange business, fully liberalizing brokerage commissions, and eliminating the obligation to use premium rates set by the non-life insurance rating organization. ... Furthermore, the full liberalization of brokerage commissions has led to expansion of trading of securities through the internet (online trading).

regulatory_fees.zh: 日本无按笔计收的证券交易监管费：不存在类似美国 Section 31 的费种——监管经费不以逐笔交易费形式向市场参与者或投资者转嫁（FSA/SESC 独立于交易所收费与 JSCC 清算费之外的监管费率表，历次抓取均未发现）；曾对证券转让征收的『有価証券取引税』已于 1999-03-31 废止（国税庁官方一手表述），现行监管体系不落在交易环节计费
regulatory_fees.en: Japan has no per-trade securities regulatory fee: there is no counterpart to the U.S. Section 31 fee — regulatory funding is not passed on as a per-trade charge (no FSA/SESC fee schedule separate from exchange fees and JSCC clearing fees has been found across repeated fetches); the former Securities Transaction Tax (有価証券取引税) on securities transfers was abolished on 31 March 1999 (per the NTA's official account), and the current regulatory system does not charge at the trade level

stamp_duty.zh: 日本对证券交易本身不征交易税（有価証券取引税已于 1999-03-31 废止，见 regulatory_fees 与 financial_transaction_tax）；现行仅在制作纸质课税文书时产生印紙税：证券转让价款的收据被第17号文書（売上代金に係る金銭又は有価証券の受取書）的注2明确排除在「売上代金」之外，适用「売上代金以外の金銭または有価証券の受取書」的简表——记载金额 5万円未満非課税、5万円以上一律 200 円；交易所电子集中交易不制作纸质文书，实际不产生印紙税——与上交所单边印花税、港交所双边印花税的形态根本不同
stamp_duty.en: Japan levies no transaction tax on securities trades (the Securities Transaction Tax was abolished on 31 March 1999 — see regulatory_fees and financial_transaction_tax); stamp duty now arises only when a paper taxable document is created: receipts for securities-sale proceeds are expressly excluded from the No.17 document class (receipts of sales proceeds) by its Note 2, so securities-transfer receipts fall under the simplified schedule for 'receipts of money or securities other than sales proceeds' — exempt below 50,000 yen and a flat 200 yen from 50,000 yen. Exchange electronic trading creates no paper document, so no stamp duty arises in practice — fundamentally different from the Shanghai (one-side) and Hong Kong (both-side) stamp duties

financial_transaction_tax.en: The former Securities Transaction Tax (levied on securities transfers) and Bourse Tax (levied on exchange-traded futures/options transactions) were abolished on March 31, 1999, as part of the FY1999 tax reform; since then Japan has not levied a transaction tax on cash-equity trades separate from income/capital-gains tax

capital_gains_tax.zh: 个人投资者出售上市股票的转让所得适用「申告分离课税」（与其他所得分开单独计税），税率为所得税15%+住民税5%（另加相应的复兴特别所得税），与股息所得选择分离课税时的税率结构一致；持有于「特定账户（源泉徵收）」的上市股票，转让损益可与同账户内的利息/股息损益相互冲抵
capital_gains_tax.en: Individual investors' gains from selling listed shares are taxed under "separate self-assessment taxation" (isolated from other income), at a combined rate of 15% national income tax plus 5% local inhabitant tax (plus the special income tax for reconstruction) — the same rate structure that applies when dividend income elects separate self-assessment taxation; for shares held in a "specified account with withholding", capital gains/losses may be aggregated against interest/dividend income within the same account
capital_gains_tax.detail: NTA英文指南原文中「15%+5%（住民税）」的费率注记直接依附在股息分离课税段落，但同一文件明确说明持仓账户内转让所得（capital gains）与股息按同一套分离课税/合并申报机制运作，二者适用同一税率结构，故据此推定资本利得税率与该注记一致；未见该指南单独给转让所得再列一次税率数字。

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 境内个人投资者持有上市股票（非大股东，持股低于3%）取得的股息，来源扣缴所得税等15.315%+住民税5%，合计20.315%；若为非上市股票股息或大股东（持股3%以上）取得的上市股票股息，仅扣缴所得税等20.42%（不含住民税）；非居民/外国法人取得的股息另按《所得税法》分离源泉课税规则处理，一般情形税率20.42%，但可能因日本与投资者居住国的税收协定而降低，具体协定税率因国而异未逐一核实
dividend_withholding_tax.en: For resident individual investors holding listed shares who are not "major shareholders" (i.e. below the 3% ownership threshold), dividends are withheld at 15.315% income tax plus 5% inhabitant tax, totaling 20.315%; dividends from unlisted stocks, or from listed stocks held by major shareholders (3% or more), are withheld at 20.42% income tax only (no inhabitant tax); non-resident individuals/foreign corporations are subject to separate withholding-at-source rules under the Income Tax Act, generally at 20.42%, though this may be reduced under an applicable Japan tax treaty — treaty-specific rates were not individually verified

implicit_costs_note.zh: 日本现货股票的隐性成本主要来自买卖价差与市场冲击；市场结构上的相关官方/研究记录：TSE 为日本股票订单流的主要集中场所，PTC（券商自营交叉盘/PTS）仅分流小部分交易——2025 年日本已无独立 PTS（Cboe Japan 退出后仅存券商系 PTS（SBI Japannext、乐天 JAX 等）），其中 Cboe Japan 退出前的股票交易份额也仅约 4–5%；订单流集中意味着 TSE 主市场的价差/深度是隐性成本的主要决定因素。逐标的实际价差官方不发布（逐笔订单簿数据为 FLEX MBO 付费产品，见 infrastructure.market_data_levels），本字段按覆盖边界停留在分析性描述
implicit_costs_note.en: Implicit costs in Japanese cash equities stem mainly from bid-ask spreads and market impact; relevant structural records: TSE concentrates the bulk of Japanese equity order flow — Japan now has no independent PTS (after Cboe Japan's withdrawal, broker-affiliated PTSs coexist with SBI Japannext), and Cboe Japan held only about a 4–5% share of equity trading before its exit; order-flow concentration means spreads/depth on the TSE book are the main determinant of implicit costs. Per-instrument realized spreads are not officially published (order-book data is the paid FLEX MBO product, see infrastructure.market_data_levels), so this note remains analytical per the coverage boundary

fx_risk_note.zh: 日元自 1973 年 2 月起实行浮动汇率制度；外汇干预依法由财务大臣行使（外汇及外国贸易法第 7 条第 3 款：「财务大臣应通过买卖外汇支付手段等必要措施稳定日元汇率」），日本银行作为财务省的代理人按需执行（BOJ 官方说明，见 sources）。对非日元投资者：东京证券交易所产品以日元计价结算，承担日元兑投资者本币的汇率风险
fx_risk_note.en: Japan introduced a floating exchange rate system in February 1973; FX intervention is legally exercised by the Minister of Finance (Article 7, Section 3 of the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act: the Minister shall endeavor to stabilize the exchange rate of Japanese currency by taking necessary measures such as buying and selling of foreign means of payment) and executed by the Bank of Japan as the Ministry of Finance's agent, as needed (BOJ outline, see sources). For non-JPY investors: TSE-listed securities are denominated and settled in JPY, carrying JPY exchange-rate risk against the investor's currency
fx_risk_note.quote: Since the introduction of a floating exchange rate system in February 1973, the Japanese economy has experienced large fluctuations in foreign exchange rates.

political_risk_note.zh: 日本自身作为七国集团成员国，未发现制裁/资本冻结类地缘政治风险的官方信号；本次抓取范围内识别到的、与「政治」相关性最强的实际制度动向是《外汇及外国贸易法》（FEFTA）近年针对半导体、国防装备、网络安全等「核心业务领域」持续扩大国家安全审查范围（见regulation.capital_controls/foreign_ownership_limit）——即政治风险主要体现为对外资并购上市公司「核心业务领域」标的的国家安全审查趋严，而非日本国内政局不稳定或对既有境外持仓的征收/冻结风险
political_risk_note.en: As a G7 member, Japan itself shows no official signal of sanctions- or asset-freeze-type geopolitical risk in the material fetched. The most politically-relevant real regulatory trend found this session is the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act's (FEFTA) recent and ongoing expansion of national-security screening over "Core Business Sectors" such as semiconductors, defense equipment and cybersecurity (see regulation.capital_controls / foreign_ownership_limit) — i.e. political risk here manifests mainly as tightening national-security review of foreign acquisitions in sensitive sectors, not domestic political instability or expropriation/freeze risk to existing foreign holdings
political_risk_note.detail: 本条是对已抓取到的FEFTA制度事实做「政治风险」角度的归纳解读，不是引用了一份专门讨论「政治风险」的官方文件；归纳本身可能带主观框架选择，故未标high。

liquidity_risk_note.zh: 流动性风险随板块显著分化：Prime市场对流通股市值/流通股数设有最高门槛（见listing.boards），是三板中流动性要求最严格的一档；Growth市场流通股市值最低门槛仅2.5亿日元、流通股数最低仅500单位（过渡期标准），显著低于Prime，意味着Growth市场个股面临更高的流动性风险（买卖价差更宽、大额交易冲击成本更高）；TOPIX等旗舰指数的成分股集中在Prime市场也从侧面反映这一分层
liquidity_risk_note.en: Liquidity risk varies markedly by market segment: the Prime Market sets the highest thresholds among the three boards for tradable-share market capitalization and tradable-share count (see listing.boards); the Growth Market's transitional tradable-share market-cap floor is only JPY0.25 billion and its tradable-share-count floor only 500 units, far below Prime — implying materially higher liquidity risk (wider bid-ask spreads, larger price impact for sizable trades) for Growth-listed issues; the concentration of flagship-index (e.g. TOPIX) constituents in the Prime Market is a further reflection of this stratification
liquidity_risk_note.detail: 本条基于listing.boards/transitional measures两页已抓取到的分板门槛数字做的推断性归纳，不是官网对「流动性风险」的直接定性表述；未找到JPX官方专门讨论买卖价差/冲击成本的量化说明页，故未标high。

enforcement_note.zh: 证券取引等监视委员会（SESC，隶属金融厅）负责市场执法：委员长与两名委员由内阁总理大臣任命、作为独立行使职权的行政委员会（任期3年）；职能覆盖对金融商品业者的检查、对内幕交易/操纵市场等市场不正当行为的调查、对上市公司披露违规的检查；发现违法后可建议对金融厅长官发出行政处分或课征金缴纳命令、提出政策建议，或对特别严重恶劣案件移送刑事立案
enforcement_note.en: The Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC), under the FSA, is the market-enforcement body: a Chairman and two Commissioners are appointed by the Prime Minister and function as independent agents (three-year terms). Its functions cover inspections of Financial Instruments Business Operators, investigations of market misconduct such as insider trading and market manipulation, and inspections of listed companies' disclosure violations. Upon finding a violation, SESC can recommend administrative actions or administrative monetary penalty payment orders, make policy proposals, or file criminal charges for particularly serious and malicious cases
